description: Search published single-question judgment cards (rubrics with public test cases). Returns one result per card at its newest version, with a `hub:owner/slug@rv_…` ref for hub_get or fork_rubric.

domain.description: Only cards filed under this domain.

hub.description: Address of the hub to ask. Default: the hub this server was started with (VERDICT_HUB_URL).

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 50.

locale.description: Only cards written for this locale, for example `ko` or `en`.

owner.description: Only cards published by this account.

q.description: matches title, author, slug and domain

name: hub_search
title: Search the hub
